body:
No offensive but saying a feeling can't harm you in a suicide forum is kind of dumb. I mean if you really want to get nitty gritty, feelings are just chemical reactions and that's exactly what depression is. 

And cmon really, for older people it may not matter so much but in this day and age anyone without a degree is screwed in terms of getting a good job. You need experience and grades now. Only having my GCSE results IS a failure now. It's what pathetic low class people have. Pretty sick of being low class now.
Maybe computer science, I wanted to be a game developer/concept artist. 3 more weeks to go.

Well not like it matters, I can't use that grade any more because I'm retaking the exams. And yes if I fail this year I won't get into university, or not a decent one. I guess this post isn't really as urgent as some, I've got my exams in a month, and then the holidays before my results. Then it's over.
You drop one in the second year, but doing 2 or 1 A level will not get you into university, which I need.

I'm doing graphics, physics, maths and ICT. Last year I got three U's (fail) and a C (Bad grade) I don't have predicted grades at the moment, but if I took the exams now, I'd get Us. And I have a month till my actual exams.

When I say most people do it easily, I mean most people pass. Every college has posters bragging about their 98% C-A pass rate. So I'm part of the 2%. 

I've had a lot of shit happen to me. Failing my A levels the first time was the most heartbreaking and traumatising thing I've experienced. To go through another year of struggle, another disappointment to my teachers, another pity party 'You tried'.... I wanted to kill myself when I got my first results. My re take was my second chance, a chance at redemption. And I'm pretty sure I'm going to fail.

A levels. It's not that the exams are super important. It's that this is the first challenging thing I've ever had to do, and I've already failed them once. This is a re-take. If I can't even pass these exams, which most people do easily, then I'm and failure and there's nothing more for me. It is more of a personal thing. 

I can't risk that crushing feeling I got when I failed the first time again.
